BC_description: The method 'Help.wrap()' has been removed from the Help class. Its previous line-wrapping and indentation logic is now separated: 'Help.boxWrap()' provides basic string wrapping (without indentation), and 'Help.formatItem()' is used for formatting and aligning term/description pairs, handling description wrapping internally. Indentation must now be added manually where needed. 'boxWrap()' takes only (str, width), and no longer supports the 'indent' parameter or partial word wrapping with zero-width spaces. Handling of colored strings (with ANSI codes) is improved: wrapping now works on visible width only. Calls to 'Help.wrap()' must be replaced with the new methods, and code relying on its automatic indentation must be adapted.
Adaptation_method:
1. Replace all usages of 'Help.wrap(str, width, indent)' with 'Help.boxWrap(str, width)' and manually add indentation if needed.
2. For formatting term/description pairs (such as command or option lists), replace manual wrapping and alignment logic by calling 'Help.formatItem(term, termWidth, description, helper)'.
3. Ensure proper handling of colored strings and edge cases in line wrapping, and update any custom indentation logic no longer handled by core methods.

Example: 
Old:
  this.wrap(desc, width, indent)
New:
  this.boxWrap(desc, width) // add indentation as needed

Old:
  this.wrap(optionText, width, indent)
New:
  this.formatItem(term, termWidth, description, helper)
